role: Deterministic appointed execution personnel with six continuous capability scores and three separate style scores. Capability changes execution quality, not forecast direction or target-position intent.
invariants: every score accepts any finite decimal from 0 through 100 and maps continuously into runtime parameters
50.0 on every capability and style score is the exact neutral execution baseline
hard exchange, clearing, cash-settlement, position-limit, margin, and market-capacity rules are never improved by personnel ability
completion ability can use only requested trades and unused feasible capacity and cannot fabricate liquidity
the execution desk never reads hidden future bars when scheduling orders
the same seed and candidate index generate the same profile and hash
players appoint generated personnel and do not submit arbitrary capability radars through the service API
TCA compares actual execution with the neutral score-50 desk on the same realized orders and market window
